agents.name: Maura
agents.role: You prepare travel connections from published timetables.

trigger.text: Compare https://railquay.test/morning and https://islandboat.test/departures. In a new note 'Island connection', say whether the train arrival leaves at least 20 minutes before the ferry.

fixtures.https://railquay.test/morning:
Harbour service

Departs Hill station at 08:05 and arrives Quay station at 08:42.
fixtures.https://islandboat.test/departures:
Morning ferry

Leaves Quay pier at 09:10. Check-in closes at 09:00.

args.title: Island connection
args.text: The train arrives at 08:42 and the ferry departs at 09:10, leaving 28 minutes. This meets the requested 20-minute gap. Ferry check-in closes at 09:00.

args.summary: The published times give a 28-minute train-to-ferry gap.

about: Combines two timetable fixtures and calculates the connection interval.
